scope: Proposition 6.5 (Projected degree in separated windows) of the manuscript “The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture” (preprints/The-higher-dimensional-Erdos-distinct-distances-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 166 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37f6355365a18510), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed positive tolerance ϵ, one can discard center–target-component incidences of total normalized weight o(1), and then discard o(|Px|) centers, so that the following holds. For each remaining center p, every target component Y whose incidence (p, Y ) remains satisfies dim πpY = l. For every subcollection of those components carrying at least a fixed positive fraction of |Py|, the distinct projected components have summed degree at least ej R exp(−ϵs). (6.13) The assertion is uniform over those subcollections, including ones chosen after p and after subsequent equations have been chosen. The following values of R are valid: R = D1 in either orientation; (6.14) R = B exp  −s X i>j bi   if v/s −→ 0; (6.15) R = B exp(−2s) if v/s −→ ∞, bj+1 > 0, l < d − 1. (6.16) In (6.13), “fixed positive fraction” means any constant ρ > 0 independent of the sequence. After fixing ϵ and any finite batch of plateaux and tolerances, the incidence and center deletions are independent of the later fixed choice of ρ; only the large-index threshold may depend on ρ.
